security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Stream RAR, ZIP and 7z archives directly over FTP without temporary extraction
bundle.longDescription: PS5 ZeroSpace FTP decompresses RAR, ZIP and 7z archives on the fly and streams their contents directly to an FTP destination without creating a temporary extracted copy on local disk.
